scenes.line1: How do you structure async code?
scenes.say: How do you organize concurrent code in Python? Which pattern should you reach for in interviews?

scenes.label: Producer
scenes.sub: Use async queues to pass data between tasks.
scenes.say: Producer-consumer is classic. Use async queues to safely pass data between tasks.

rows.b: Executors map work to threads or processes

scenes.say: You’ll see three main patterns: producer-consumer, fan-out and fan-in with gather, and parallel map with executors.
Fan-out and fan-in means running tasks at once and collecting their results with gather.

scenes.question: When do you use an async queue?
scenes.right: To coordinate async producers and consumers
scenes.say: Don’t mix up async queues with CPU-bound work. Use queues for coordinating async producers and consumers.
